description: GB Transportation Network (1:50 000 Meridian 2) is a data set deposited in bl.ed by its authors Guy McGarva. This is the transportation data from the Ordnance Survey Meridian 2 product. It contains Motorways, A roads, B roads, minor roads, roundabouts, junction numbers, railways, railway stations and the coastline. Each feature is in a separate Shapefile. Each Shapefile covers the whole of Great Britain. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is released as part of the OS Open Data initiative. This data is made available under the Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0 whose full text can be found at http://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/pddl/1.0/.. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
